By way of this writ petition, the petitioner has, inter alia, prayed for the following reliefs:-
Kamla Devi vs State Of H.P. & Anr on 16 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32358779/
1 (i) "That writ in the nature of mandamus may kindly be issued and the respondent department may be directed to acquire the land of the petitioner with in time bound period as per the provision of law since the respondents have used the valuable land of the petitioner for the construction of water tank.

sentences.text: (ii) That the respondents be directed to acquire the land and also award the compensation to the present petitioner in accordance with law in alternate the respondent be directed to restore the land in its original position and pay the damages caused to the land.

(iii) That the use and occupation charges from 2020 to till date be granted with interest @ 18% per annum .
to till date."

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner has drawn the attention of the Court to the reply filed by the respondents in general and Para-3 of the preliminary submissions in particular, of wherein, it stands submitted that the Executive Engineer, JSV, Division Dharampur, has already initiated steps for acquisition rt of the disputed land under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation Act, 2013 and that the petitioner will be called for negotiation before the Committee which has been constituted for the said purpose.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Learned Law Officer submits that the proceedings which have been initiated under the provisions of the above mentioned act shall be taken to their logical conclusion as expeditiously as possible.

Let needful be done in accordance with law within a period of three months from today and with these observation this writ petition is disposed of primarily in view of the admitted position that the land of the petitioner indeed has been utilized for the purpose of construction of the water tank and now steps stand initiated by the respondent to acquire this land.

Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, .
also stands disposed of.
